name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Strong Republican district lean of R+11
Incumbent Keith Self running for reelection with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price Self at about 94% to win
No public polling of the general election
model.rationale: The district's R+11 lean, Self's incumbency and fundraising advantage, and markets pricing him near 94% all point to a comfortable Republican hold, with no polling or ratings suggesting movement toward Hunt.
model.watch: A late surge in Democratic spending or polling showing Hunt within single digits would be the main signal this race is tightening.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-03 is a solidly Republican Collin County seat, and incumbent Keith Self is seeking reelection after easily securing his party's nomination. The district's R+11 partisan lean and the incumbent's structural advantages make this a difficult climb for Democrat Evan Hunt.

Hunt has raised a modest sum and enters the fall with limited cash, while Self has out-raised him and holds a financial edge. No public polls of the race are available, and prediction markets give Self roughly a 94% chance of winning. The forecast expects Self to hold the seat by a double-digit margin, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
